long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Rüdesheim, Müller managed a publishing house at 19 and later trained in medicine before choosing advertising. He founded Lunenburg & Partner in Berlin, then created a media-services company focused on outdoor advertising. A partnership with Heinz W. Ströer opened new markets after German reunification, beginning with extensive advertising rights in eastern Germany.

Müller subsequently combined local street furniture, transport advertising and large-format displays into a broader sales platform. Acquisitions of municipal and railway advertising businesses established national scale. Later moves into online marketing, digital publishing and direct customer communication changed Ströer from a billboard operator into an integrated media company. He continues to lead strategy, acquisitions and development of the group's outdoor infrastructure.
